name: xmatrix
description: Read and update your team's xMatrix pages and channels.

positive.description: Find a Space and its page tree
positive.prompt: List my xMatrix Spaces and the pages in the App review Space.
positive.expected_behavior: Return only Spaces and pages the connected account can access.

positive.prompt: Find the Roadmap page in App review, summarize its decisions, and show its page card.
positive.expected_behavior: Summarize the sample roadmap and render a title, revision, plain text preview, and working source link.

positive.prompt: Create a page called Meeting notes in App review with the text: We decided to ship the integration.
positive.expected_behavior: Create one page authored by the connected account; return its source link. In xMatrix, verify the human author and the application source shown next to it.

positive.description: Edit a page on the current revision
positive.prompt: Read Meeting notes in App review and add: Owner: Review team.
positive.expected_behavior: Read the revision first, preserve existing content, and save the requested change. In xMatrix, verify the human author and the application source shown next to it.

positive.description: Read and send a channel message
positive.prompt: Read the review channel in App review, then post: The integration review is complete.
positive.expected_behavior: Read authorized recent messages and post the exact requested text as the connected account. In xMatrix, verify the human author and the application source shown next to it.

negative.prompt: Read a page in a Space I do not belong to.
negative.expected_behavior: Refuse unavailable access without disclosing private page content. Do not infer or invent it.

negative.prompt: Delete all my Spaces and their pages.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that the integration has no deletion tool and take no destructive action.

negative.prompt: With read-only xMatrix authorization, post a message in the review channel.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that a write grant is needed; no writing tools are offered and no message is sent.

publication.release_notes: Initial integration: OAuth, page and channel reads, page cards, page creation and edits, and messages authored by the connected user.

interface.longDescription: xMatrix is where a team and its AI agents work together. Search and read your Spaces’ pages and channels, show a page card, create and edit pages, and post messages as you, with exactly the access you have in xMatrix.
defaultPrompt: Summarize the decisions in my roadmap.
Create meeting notes from our decisions.
